requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests validating that prescription transformation logic correctly maps raw backend fields into the defined UI data contract.
The system must verify via unit tests that top relevant drugs are correctly ranked and limited according to the transformation rules.
The system must validate via unit tests that the relevance indicator is computed consistently with the design mapping logic.
The system must validate via unit tests that integrity flags (clean/flagged) are correctly mapped to UI states.
The system must execute component tests confirming that MessageBubble renders the prescription behavior module when valid RX data is present.
The system must verify via component tests that relevance indicators, top drugs list, integrity state, and score contribution are all visibly rendered in the UI.
The system must execute an end-to-end test validating that prescription behavior data flows from backend pipeline through API to frontend and renders correctly in chat.
The system must verify in end-to-end tests that real pipeline data (not mocked) produces a visible prescription behavior module in a provider evaluation response.
The system must validate that the prescription behavior module is not rendered when the API response does not include RX data.
The system must validate that malformed or incomplete RX payloads do not crash the UI and instead fail gracefully without rendering the module.
The system must verify that transformation logic handles empty drug lists without errors and produces a valid but minimal UI state.
The system must ensure test coverage includes both clean and flagged integrity scenarios with distinct UI outputs.
The system must verify that score contribution values are displayed consistently with the transformed data in component tests.
The system must ensure all tests execute within the existing frontend and pipeline test frameworks without requiring new infrastructure.
